import pandas as pd

# Read the source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_67/training_0.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Group by 'user_id' and compute average of 'sad.depressed' and 'open.stressed'
agg_df = df.groupby('user_id', as_index=False).agg({
    'sad.depressed': 'mean',
    'open.stressed': 'mean'
})

# Rename columns to match target schema
agg_df.rename(columns={
    'sad.depressed': 'sad',
    'open.stressed': 'stressed'
}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema
agg_df['user_id'] = agg_df['user_id'].astype(int)
agg_df['sad'] = agg_df['sad'].astype(float)
agg_df['stressed'] = agg_df['stressed'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the specified output path without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_67/target_multisource.csv"
agg_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
